name: bind 'key' 'action'
desc: creates a keybinding from key to action. See the keybindings documentation for more information about binding keys. This command will modify bindings.json and overwrite any bindings to key that already exist.

name: help ['topic'] ['flags']
desc: opens the corresponding help topics. If no topic is provided opens the default help screen. If multiple topics are provided (separated via ) they are opened all as splits. Help topics are stored as .md files in the runtime/help directory of the source tree, which is embedded in the final binary. The flags are optional. * -hsplit: Opens the help topic in a horizontal split * -vsplit: Opens the help topic in a vertical split

name: save ['filename']
desc: saves the current buffer. If the file is provided it will 'save as' the filename.

name: goto 'line[:col]'
desc: goes to the given absolute line (and optional column) number. A negative number can be passed to go inward from the end of the file. Example: -5 goes to the 5th-last line in the file.

name: jump 'line[:col]'
desc: goes to the given relative number from the current line (and optional absolute column) number. Example: -5 jumps 5 lines up in the file, while (+)3 jumps 3 lines down.

name: replace 'search' 'value' ['flags']
desc: This will replace search with value. The flags are optional. Possible flags are: * -a: Replace all occurrences at once * -l: Do a literal search instead of a regex search

name: replaceall 'search' 'value'
desc: this will replace all occurrences of search with value without user confirmation.

name: set 'option' 'value'
desc: sets the option to value. See the options help topic for a list of options you can set. This will modify your settings.json with the new value.

name: setlocal 'option' 'value'
desc: sets the option to value locally (only in the current buffer). This will *not* modify settings.json.

name: toggle 'option'
desc: toggles the option. Only works with options that accept exactly two values. This will modify your settings.json with the new value.

name: togglelocal 'option'
desc: toggles the option locally (only in the current buffer). Only works with options that accept exactly two values. This will *not* modify settings.json.

name: reset 'option'
desc: resets the given option to its default value.

name: show 'option'
desc: shows the current value of the given option.

name: showkey 'key'
desc: Show the action(s) bound to a given key. For example running > showkey Ctrl-c will display Copy.

name: run 'sh-command'
desc: runs the given shell command in the background. The command's output will be displayed in one line when it finishes running.

name: vsplit ['filename']
desc: opens a vertical split with filename. If no filename is provided, a vertical split is opened with an empty buffer. If multiple files are provided (separated via ) they are opened all as splits.

name: hsplit ['filename']
desc: same as vsplit but opens a horizontal split instead of a vertical split.

name: tab ['filename']
desc: opens the given file in a new tab. If no filename is provided, a tab is opened with an empty buffer. If multiple files are provided (separated via ) they are opened all as tabs.

name: tabmove '[-+]n'
desc: Moves the active tab to another slot. n is an integer. If n is prefixed with - or +, then it represents a relative position (e.g. tabmove +2 moves the tab to the right by 2). If n has no prefix, it represents an absolute position (e.g. tabmove 2 moves the tab to slot 2).

name: tabswitch 'tab'
desc: This command will switch to the specified tab. The tab can either be a tab number, or a name of a tab.

name: textfilter 'sh-command'
desc: filters the current selection through a shell command as standard input and replaces the selection with the stdout of the shell command. For example, to sort a list of numbers, first select them, and then execute > textfilter sort -n.

name: log
desc: opens a log of all messages and debug statements.

name: plugin update ['pl']
desc: update a plugin (if no arguments are provided updates all plugins).

name: plugin search 'pl'
desc: search available plugins for a keyword.

name: plugin available
desc: show available plugins that can be installed.

name: reload
desc: reloads all runtime files (settings, keybindings, syntax files, colorschemes, plugins). All plugins will be unloaded by running their deinit() function (if it exists), and then loaded again by calling the preinit(), init() and postinit() functions (if they exist).

name: cd 'path'
desc: Change the working directory to the given path.

name: open 'filename'
desc: Open a file in the current buffer.

name: reopen
desc: Reopens the current file from disk.

name: retab
desc: Replaces all leading tabs with spaces or leading spaces with tabs depending on the value of tabstospaces.

name: raw
desc: micro will open a new tab and show the escape sequence for every event it receives from the terminal. This shows you what micro actually sees from the terminal and helps you see which bindings aren't possible and why. This is most useful for debugging keybindings.

name: term ['exec']
desc: Open a terminal emulator running the given executable. If no executable is given, this will open the default shell in the terminal emulator.

name: lint
desc: Lint the current file for errors.

name: comment
desc: automatically comment or uncomment current selection or line.
